hypothesis_formulation.rationale: No Cause→Effect→Why template exists. strategy-specification skill focuses on 6-element framework (Universe/Entry/Exit/Sizing/Risk/Timeframe) but lacks hypothesis structure.

parameter_locking.rationale: No mechanism to enforce single-parameter specification. Current schema allows arbitrary parameter objects without cardinality constraints.

failure_analysis.rationale: contingency-planner agent has failure-mode-analysis.md with probability×impact scoring. However, NOT integrated with strategy-builder and lacks trading-specific failure modes (regime mismatch, overfitting, curve-fitting).

regime_detection.rationale: risk-management-specialist/docs/volatility-regimes.md has percentile-based ATR classification (LOW/NORMAL/HIGH). pattern-detector has ADX-based regime classification. Neither integrated for hypothesis failure attribution.

trial_counting.rationale: No trial counter or optimization attempt tracker exists. No mechanism to limit parameter exploration iterations.

walk_forward.rationale: No walk-forward optimization coordination capability. No out-of-sample validation orchestration. strategy-builder explicitly excludes backtesting.

anti_overfitting.rationale: pattern-detection.md mentions anti-pattern 'Over-Optimization' and recommends industry-standard defaults. No formal parameter count limits or overfitting detection.

backtest_coordination.rationale: No backtester agent exists. strategy-builder explicitly states 'NO backtesting' in boundaries. HDD requires single backtest execution per hypothesis.

missing_skills.description: Cause→Effect→Why hypothesis template with parameter locking. Must enforce single-parameter specification per hypothesis and generate testable predictions.
Single-backtest execution coordinator. Runs ONE backtest per hypothesis against pre-defined failure criteria. Returns pass/fail with metrics.
Backtest failure root cause analysis. Three-step check: Bug check → Stability check → Logic check. Outputs NEW hypothesis recommendation.
Hypothesis trial counter with configurable limits (default: 5 trials per strategy idea). Tracks parameter count, enforces anti-overfitting constraints.
Walk-forward optimization orchestration. Manages in-sample/out-of-sample splits, rolling window advancement, and validation aggregation.

enhancement_opportunities.enhancement: Extend 6-element framework to include hypothesis_block with Cause→Effect→Why fields and parameter_constraints object enforcing single-parameter rule
Add failure_attribution method that correlates backtest losses with volatility regime at failure time. Integrate volatility-regimes.md classification.
Add trading-specific failure mode catalog: curve-fitting, regime-mismatch, insufficient-trades, correlation-breakdown, slippage-assumption-violation
Formalize over-optimization detection into reusable skill with parameter_count_limit, lookback_ratio_check, degrees_of_freedom validation

agent_coordination_gaps.description: strategy-builder generates QC skeletons but cannot validate them. HDD requires single-backtest-per-hypothesis workflow. No agent currently owns backtest execution.
agent_coordination_gaps.recommendation: Create backtester agent with modes: single_run (HDD), walk_forward, monte_carlo. Should delegate to QuantConnect Cloud API or LEAN engine.

agent_coordination_gaps.gap: pattern-detector not integrated for failure attribution
agent_coordination_gaps.description: pattern-detector has regime classification (ADX-based) and multi-indicator coordination but operates independently. Should correlate failure timestamps with detected regimes.
agent_coordination_gaps.recommendation: Add failure_context_enrichment operation to pattern-detector that accepts timestamp range and returns regime/pattern state at failure points.

agent_coordination_gaps.description: technical-indicator-specialist computes indicators but has no awareness of hypothesis constraints. Could validate that strategy uses only pre-approved indicator set.
agent_coordination_gaps.recommendation: Add indicator_constraint_validation mode that checks strategy spec against allowed indicator list (prevents indicator shopping/overfitting).

agent_coordination_gaps.description: Circuit breaker and position sizing exist but no correlation analysis between risk events and hypothesis failures. Could identify if failures cluster around risk limit triggers.
agent_coordination_gaps.recommendation: Add risk_event_correlation operation that analyzes backtest equity curve against circuit breaker activations and heat limit breaches.

agent_coordination_gaps.description: No agent or workflow coordinates the Design→Create→Validate→Fix cycle. Each step requires manual orchestration currently.
agent_coordination_gaps.recommendation: Either extend strategy-builder with HDD modes OR create dedicated hdd-orchestrator agent that coordinates hypothesis lifecycle across existing agents.
